cards.title: Pediatrician: Human Connection Matters More Than AI
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection is the biggest threat to children, not technology. The solution to screen time concerns is spending more time talking openly with each other.

cards.title: Why Some Boys Hide Their Love of Reading
cards.body: In a culture dominated by electronics, many young boys learn that being a reader is socially risky. This perception can discourage a potentially transformative habit.

cards.title: Joy and Play Unlock Children's Learning Potential
cards.body: Joyful play and arts-based emotional connection unlock the brain's capacity for learning. These approaches transform daily resistance into powerful educational opportunities.

cards.title: Peer Victimization Damages Teens' Self-Image Long-Term
cards.body: A study found that peer victimization predicted worse self-portrayals the following year. The impact is largely due to victimization persisting over extended periods.

cards.title: Acknowledging Mothers Who Managed It All While Exhausted
cards.body: The phrase 'they did it tired' speaks to mothers' dual journeys as survivors and caregivers. This quiet sacrifice deserves recognition and respect.
